# Echelon stage 3b — the data

and `fits_analyze.py` (exact ML from the stage II start). The study is

# Part 2: exact ML from the stage II start

`echelon_ls` is `Ladder(echelon=n, start="echelon")`; the other forms are
stage 3a's ([`STUDY-echelon-form-data.md`](STUDY-echelon-form-data.md)), on
the same data. nobs 200, 50 replications.

## How the search stops

termcode 1: gradient; 2: step; 3: no improvement (BUG-0010: the flat
directions of a weakly identified model); wall: an MA inverse root on
the invertibility boundary at the stop.
